name: bug
description: Something does not work as specified

name: design
description: Needs drawing before it can be built

name: ready
description: Specified and drawn: the next session may take it

name: in-progress
description: A session is working on it

description: Waits on the owner; a pull request with it does not merge

name: blocked
description: Waits on another issue, named in its body
